_meta.description: FacetSchema summarising a filtered experiment cohort's region distribution decorated with an OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_POP group overlay that scores each region's subset frequency against the population frequency from an unfiltered comparison cohort (100 * subset_freq / pop_freq). First FACET-host overlay (E5-S2): GROUP scope, Ref.Population names the comparison cohort, one SeriesEntry per host value carrying the index on Summary.Statistic. Streamable — runs as a post-finalize fold over the host's per-value distribution against the resolver's population view. Pop frequencies of zero emit PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO and skip the entry; renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 100.
_meta.name: facet-index-vs-pop
